kampfmedizin.summary: You bandage your own wounds in the middle of combat; at higher levels bandaging costs no turn and can even reduce the wound's severity.

grosse-macht.summary: You gain a bonus to Krach rolls on brute-force tasks such as breaking doors, lifting and grappling.

sturmbrecher.summary: You charge the enemy at a run and knock them to the ground; at higher level you can also topple a second person in your path.

titan.summary: Once per combat, you land a devastating blow that hits without a roll and advances the wound 2 stages; you must rest the next turn.

wurgegriff.summary: You lock an enemy and stop them from attacking; if you hold for two turns, they silently pass out.

herr-der-toten.summary: Each enemy you kill gives you a Death Burden; you spend these to lessen the wounds you take.

mein-liebe.summary: You don't feel the penalties of light wounds at all and feel severe wounds less. In exchange, you permanently lose your Death Save.

endsieg-der-mann.summary: At the moment of your death you fight on for 2 more turns; if you kill your killer during this time, you survive.

kampfveteran.summary: You shoot accurately even while wounded; at higher levels you also gain a bonus to panic (Cower) rolls.

snipe.summary: You aim for a turn to empower your next shot, and if it hits, you choose the limb you strike.

lauerstellung.summary: When you fire from a hidden position, it becomes very hard for the enemy to locate you.

ein-schuss.summary: A critical Snipe shot instantly takes out an ordinary enemy; on elite targets the wound advances 3 stages.

feuerleitung.summary: You mark a target; your teammates' shots at that target get easier.

zweihandler.summary: In the same turn you make two separate shots with two one-handed weapons; the penalty goes away as the level rises.

panzerknacker.summary: Your shots that hit vehicles, armored vehicles and augmented limbs deal more wounds.

engel-des-todes.summary: Your Aim rolls grow stronger with each kill; but a combat that ends with too much built up brings Corruption.

silent-step-low-profile.summary: You gain a bonus to Leis rolls while moving stealthily.

throwing-expertise.summary: With thrown weapons such as knives you use Leis instead of Aim; if you hit unnoticed, you wound more.

giftmischer.summary: You prepare poisons: you coat your weapon, make knockout drugs, or mix them into food.

silent-takedown.summary: You silently take out an enemy you approached unnoticed in a single move.

dunkelhand.summary: You master pickpocketing and theft; you can even plant something on the target.

the-great-pretender.summary: With clothing and documents you disguise yourself as someone else; at higher level you can do it even unprepared.

der-maulwurf.summary: You establish a lasting false identity in a faction and gather information from the inside.

saboteur.summary: You sabotage vehicles, weapons and machines unnoticed; at higher level you choose when the malfunction occurs.

volksredner.summary: You call out to your allies, ending their panic (Cower) and strengthening their rolls.

fahnentrager.summary: Once per session you rally a crowd or a small unit to a cause.

see-through-em.summary: You read the intentions, lies and weaknesses of the person you are talking to.

schlangenzunge.summary: Your lies become more convincing; you can save an exposed lie with a new lie.

verhormeister.summary: You get a subdued person to talk and give true answers to your questions (no torture involved).

kriegsengineer.summary: You repair broken equipment; at higher levels also in the middle of combat, and augments too.

maschinengehirn.summary: You find the weak points of machines and augmented enemies and deal more wounds.

sprengmeister.summary: You prepare and place explosives; you can set up timers, traps and directional charges.

eiserner-kamerad.summary: Once per campaign, you build a small combat robot that accompanies you.

panzerschrauber.summary: You drive military vehicles better, repair them in the field, and use vehicle weapons with Werk.

knowledge-of-future.summary: Makes it easier to figure out and use unknown experimental devices (Wunderwaffe).

kriegssheilung.summary: The bandages you apply to others are more effective; you can heal wounds outside of combat.

aryan-cryptology.summary: You decipher coded SS science texts and learn secrets and plans; the cost is Corruption.

kluger-kopf.summary: During a long rest you try to lower your Corruption.

siegel-der-leere.summary: Black magic that marks a target with a void rune; each use gives Corruption.

siegel-der-verdamm.summary: You draw a curse rune into the flesh of a subdued enemy; each use gives Corruption.

grosses-siegel.summary: You draw a large rune on the ground and either protect or curse the area; it carries a heavy Corruption cost.

extracio-aus-ss.summary: You ask a corpse questions and gain information (black magic).

totenruf.summary: You summon the soul of someone recently dead and use it as an invisible scout that passes through walls.

toter-soldaten.summary: You raise a corpse as a servant that obeys simple orders; the cost is heavy Corruption.

blutopfer.summary: You wound your own limb to empower a black magic roll.

stahlnerv.summary: Reduces the negative stat effects of your augments.

zweite-haut.summary: Your augmented limbs become resistant to wounds and cannot be severed; they can be repaired.

kalte-seele.summary: You benefit from Corruption's Klang bonus earlier and use Klang on panic rolls; the more augments you have, the harder speaking gets.

neuer-mensch.summary: You can fit a second augment to a limb; with many augments, passing the Death Save gets easier.

ersatzteil.summary: You remove and fit your augments in the field, repair them, or transfer them to another limb.

uberladung.summary: You overload one of your augments to empower your next augment action; it requires a control roll.

schnittstelle.summary: You connect your augmented hand or arm to vehicles and machines and control them directly.

kriegsmaschine.summary: Once per combat, for 2 turns, you overload all your augments without rolling and take extra actions.

federfuss.summary: Spring-loaded foot prosthesis: you stay silent while running and are wounded less by falls.

funkohr.summary: A radio built into your head: you listen to open frequencies and communicate silently with others who have the same augment.

glasauge.summary: You see distant details better; in sudden bright light you are blinded for a turn.

laufwerk.summary: Motorized leg frame: running, jumping and climbing get easier. If the Akku (battery) runs out, you take a penalty.

stahlfinger.summary: You never let go of what you grip, and squeezing and tearing grow stronger; you struggle with fine handiwork.

akkutrager.summary: A large battery worn on your belt gives extra charge to your augments that use Akku; it can explode on a severe wound.

klingenarm.summary: A blade hidden in your arm: hard to find when you are searched, it wounds more in melee.

panzerhaut.summary: Covers your upper body with armor, so you are wounded less; but you become cumbersome and struggle to swim.

sturmarm.summary: Powerful motorized arm: by spending battery you strike very hard and lift heavy objects.

geistauge.summary: You see living beings behind walls and gain a bonus to black magic; each use carries a risk of Corruption.

gletschkanon.summary: A heavy Gletschmetall cannon integrated into the arm. In exchange for great firepower it brings very heavy stat penalties (especially -5 Werk).

schwarzes-herz.summary: Saves you from death once and heals your wounds; each use gives Corruption.

ubermann.summary: Physical strength tree (Korp): melee, endurance and not dying.

stahlkrieg.summary: Marksmanship tree (Aim): sniping, fire support and assault troops.

spionage.summary: Stealth tree (Leis): assassination, disguise and sabotage.

diplomat.summary: Communication tree (Rede): persuasion, leadership, lies and interrogation.

wunderwaffe.summary: Engineering tree (Werk): repair, explosives, vehicles and experimental technology.

schwarzesonne.summary: Black magic tree (Wissen): runes and the dead. It is powerful but carries a Corruption cost.

metallkorp.summary: Augment tree (Klang): a body fused with the machine.

careful-runner.summary: You fall and collide less when running fast; you cannot run fast in the dark.

one-hander.summary: You are good with one-handed melee weapons and bad with two-handed ones.

two-hander.summary: You are good with two-handed melee weapons and bad with one-handed ones.

kench.summary: You are resistant to food poisoning.

bladesmith.summary: You are more successful with short blades.

falscher.summary: You are a master of forging documents, seals and identities.

feldsanitater.summary: The bandages you apply do not get dirty.

katze.summary: You see better in the dark.

ortskundig.summary: In a region you choose, finding your way and communicating with the locals get easier.

schwarzmarkt.summary: Finding forbidden and scarce goods gets easier, and prices drop.

trilingual.summary: You start the game knowing 3 languages.

adlerauge.summary: You aim faster and land critical hits more often.

extrovert.summary: +2 Rede: you communicate easily with strangers.

gluckspilz.summary: Once per session you reroll a Nat1 without spending Inspiration.

heimwerker.summary: Your rolls on mechanical work get easier.

runenkundig.summary: Your black magic rolls for Siegel (rune) abilities get easier.

tesla.summary: Your rolls on electronics work get easier.

cheetah.summary: +2 Agil: you run fast and do parkour.

metallvertraglich.summary: +2 Klang: you adapt to augments more easily.

ruthig.summary: Moving stealthily gets easier for you.

beherzt.summary: Your Corruption rises with more difficulty.

adaptable.summary: You are far less affected by environmental conditions such as heat and cold.

ubermuscler.summary: You lift very heavy things and handle heavy weapons more easily.

ubermensch.summary: Your physical rolls get easier and you take fewer wounds.

veteran-of-47.summary: You are unaffected by psychological conditions (panic, shock).

tiryaki.summary: Cigarette addiction: as the addiction grows, you gain Corruption.

analphabet.summary: You cannot read; you cannot take the Aryan Cryptology ability.

ayyas.summary: Alcohol addiction: as the addiction grows, you gain Corruption.

empfi.summary: Sensitive stomach: you are prone to food poisoning.

kurzsichtig.summary: Without your glasses, -2 to Sicht and Aim rolls against distant targets.

monolingual.summary: You start the game knowing one language.

verschuldet.summary: You start with no money, and a creditor is after you.

blutscheu.summary: You are shaken when you see severe wounds and struggle with first aid.

ehrenkodex.summary: If you harm someone who has surrendered or is unarmed, you gain +2 Corruption.

gesucht.summary: A faction is looking for you; you may be recognized in their territory.

klaustrophob.summary: -1 to all rolls in cramped and enclosed spaces.

oaf.summary: You are clumsy and may make faulty moves.

okkultphobie.summary: When you see black magic you may fall into panic (Cower).

schlaflos.summary: If you sleep badly, -1 to all rolls until the next long rest.

gottesfurchtig.summary: You struggle greatly with black magic and gain extra Corruption.

introvert.summary: -2 Rede: you struggle to communicate with strangers.

kriegszitterer.summary: You may fall into panic (Cower) at the sound of explosions and artillery.

laut.summary: Moving stealthily gets much harder for you.

recovered.summary: If you use drugs, alcohol or tobacco, you gain Corruption directly.

delicate.summary: You are wounded more easily and heal more slowly.

metallabstossung.summary: -2 Klang: your body rejects augments, with a risk of injury at each fitting.

runenblind.summary: You cannot take Siegel abilities and struggle with black magic.

such-tiger.summary: Pervitin addiction: affects your Krach, and as the addiction grows, you gain Corruption.

unthermo.summary: You are strongly affected by heat and cold.

kriegsversehrt.summary: One or two of your limbs start severed; one limb grants 4 perk points, two limbs grant 7.

zargana.summary: Your physical rolls get harder and you take more wounds.

schizo.summary: You see things that aren't there; -2 Rede, -2 Leis.

pressured-pacifism.summary: If you harm someone you gain Corruption; if you kill, +3.

korp.summary: Physical resistance: withstanding wounds, poison and fatigue.

krach.summary: Physical power: melee and brute force.

klang.summary: Augment compatibility: the ability to bear and use augments. Everyone starts at 2.

sanita.summary: Mental resistance: withstanding fear, panic and terror.

rede.summary: Communication: persuasion, lies, bargaining and leadership.

wissen.summary: Accumulated knowledge; Schwarzesonne black magic is also rolled with this stat.

sicht.summary: Noticing, catching details, finding someone who is hiding.

werk.summary: Engineering and manual dexterity: repair, explosives, machines.

aim.summary: Aiming: accuracy with firearms and thrown weapons.

corruption.summary: Dark forces gnawing at the character. It ranges from 0 to 13; new effects unlock as it rises, and at 13 the character dies. Once it reaches 7, it never drops below 7 again.

cower.summary: The state of cowering in fear (unlocks at Corruption 5). You roll Sanita to break free.

frenzy.summary: The state of losing yourself after killing an enemy (unlocks at Corruption 9).

nat20.summary: Rolling a 20 on the d20: critical success.

nat1.summary: Rolling a 1 on the d20: critical failure.

death-save.summary: The roll that decides whether you survive when you take a mortal wound.

inspiration.summary: A point the GM awards; spend it to reroll a roll.

pervitin.summary: A methamphetamine pill issued to soldiers. It affects Corruption and is addictive; used only at the GM's request.

akku.summary: The charge of some augments and machines; it recharges only in a place with grid electricity.

gletschmetall.summary: A light but extremely hard, supernatural metal developed by the Germans at Narvik.

uber.summary: The highest difficulty threshold (22). For tasks normally considered impossible.
